name: Contact-royce_talk_sms_consent
label: SMS Marketing Consent
description: Recipient has explicitly agreed to receive marketing SMS. Required for RoyceTalk SMS Campaign targeting -- off by default, no bulk send ever includes a Contact without this checked.

name: Lead-royce_talk_sms_opted_out
label: Opted Out of SMS
description: By design, Leads are included in RoyceTalk SMS Campaigns by default (opt-out model, unlike Customer Contacts which are opt-in). Check this to exclude an individual Lead. Leads with status "Do Not Contact" are always excluded regardless.
